# Ethena

> Ethena is a scalable ethics and compliance training platform delivering customizable courses on sexual harassment prevention, workplace safety, and data security across global markets and industries.

Ethena provides mandatory compliance training solutions with 93% approval ratings, supporting SCORM/LMS integration and multi-language delivery. The platform offers jurisdiction-specific courses for US states, Canada, UK, Australia, India, and Japan, plus industry-focused training for manufacturing, retail, and warehouse environments.

## Key Topics

- Sexual Harassment Prevention Training
- Compliance Training
- SCORM/LMS Integration
- Workplace Safety
- AI Customization
- Multi-Language Support
- Mandatory Training
- Harassment Reporting
- Data Privacy (GDPR/CCPA)
- Cybersecurity Awareness
- Title VII Compliance
- State-Specific Requirements
- Employee Training Platform
- Bystander Intervention
- Workplace Harassment Prevention

## Core Platform & Courses

- [Compliance & Sexual Harassment Training - Ethena](https://www.goethena.com): Ethena: scalable ethics & compliance platform with 93% approval rating
- [Training Course Library - Ethena](https://www.goethena.com/courses): Ethena's course library with dynamic content covering compliance standards

## Sexual Harassment Prevention Training

- [Federal Sexual Harassment Prevention Training - Ethena](https://www.goethena.com/courses/federal-harassment-training-requirements): Federal sexual harassment prevention training meeting Title VII requirements
- [Harassment Prevention Training: Global Sexual Harassment - Ethena](https://www.goethena.com/courses/sexual-harassment-training): Global sexual harassment prevention training for workplace safety

- [Maine Sexual Harassment Training - Ethena](https://www.goethena.com/courses/maine-sexual-harassment-training): Maine sexual harassment training with manager responsibilities included

## International Compliance Training

- [Sexual Harassment Training UK - Ethena](https://www.goethena.com/courses/sexual-harassment-training-uk): UK Equality Act sexual harassment prevention and reporting training
- [Sexual Harassment Training Australia - Ethena](https://www.goethena.com/courses/sexual-harassment-training-australia): Australia Respect at Work Bill compliance sexual harassment prevention training
- [Harassment + Workplace Violence Prevention Training for Canada](https://www.goethena.com/courses/sexual-harassment-training-canada): Canada harassment and workplace violence prevention training with French support
- [Sexual Harassment Training India - Ethena](https://www.goethena.com/courses/sexual-harassment-training-india): India PoSH Act sexual harassment training with Internal Complaints Committee
- [Power Harassment (Japan) - Harassment Prevention Training - Ethena](https://www.goethena.com/courses/power-harassment-japan): Japan power harassment prevention training for workplace safety
